versions.changelog:
audio-transcriber 1.0.0

- Initial release of the audio-transcriber skill, supporting audio transcription using OpenAI Whisper.
- Features live recording, speech-to-text, emotion detection, and multi-language translation.
- Provides enhanced hearing with transcript, emotion analysis, and translation in a single command.
- Includes basic audio analysis (energy, zero-crossing rate, spectral centroid) and audio noise reduction.
- Supports file and direct byte-array transcription without ffmpeg.
- Chinese/English SKILL.md with usage scenarios, subcommands, code snippets, and dependencies.
